# Vendored front-end libraries

Saved inside the project so the app works offline (B.2). There is no JavaScript build step.

| Library | Version | Files | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.8 | `bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/ |
| HTMX | 2.0.11 | `htmx/htmx.min.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.11/dist/ |
| Chart.js | 4.5.1 | `chartjs/chart.umd.min.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/ |

To upgrade, download the new files to the same paths and update this table.
